name: How much does a shower or tub upgrade cost in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a shower or tub upgrade cost in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a shower or tub upgrade in the East Bay area varies widely based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and labor. A basic replacement might start around $3,000, while a complete renovation with custom features and high-end materials could exceed $15,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary, from $3,000 for basic replacements to over $15,000 for full renovations in the East Bay.
